cc29139f433c8408d174b1a98fe78074738182c0.definition: The stability control has a fault, or it has intervened and the car lost grip. Severity level 3 — Warning. Action: Drive carefully and have the system checked..
cc29139f433c8408d174b1a98fe78074738182c0.gloss: The stability control has a fault, or it has intervened and the car lost grip.

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.definition: The tokens the model generates, counted and billed on the way out. Long answers cost more than short ones.
ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.gloss: The tokens the model generates, counted and billed on the way out. Long answers cost more than short ones.

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.definition: 生成された出力を分割した単位で、出力時に数えられ、料金にも反映される。回答が長いほど数が多くなる。
ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.gloss: モデルが回答として生成するトークン。

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.definition: 모델이 답을 생성하면서 만들어 낸 토큰의 총수이다. 입력 토큰과 별도로 계산되며, 출력이 길수록 일반적으로 비용이 더 많이 든다.
ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.gloss: 모델이 생성하여 내보내는 토큰의 수로, 출력 과정에 따라 계산되고 과금된다.

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.definition: Unidades de texto produzidas por um modelo de linguagem e cobradas quando a resposta é gerada. Respostas mais longas normalmente exigem mais tokens de saída.
ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.gloss: São os tokens gerados pelo modelo e contabilizados na saída.

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.definition: Unit teks yang dihasilkan model, yang kemudian dihitung dan dibebankan biaya. Jawaban yang lebih panjang umumnya membutuhkan lebih banyak token dan biaya.
ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.gloss: Token keluaran yang dihasilkan oleh model.

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.definition: หน่วยข้อความที่โมเดลสร้างออกมาและนำมานับเพื่อคิดค่าใช้จ่าย คำตอบที่ยาวกว่าจะใช้โทเคนมากกว่าและมีค่าใช้จ่ายสูงกว่า
ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.gloss: โทเคนผลลัพธ์ที่โมเดลสร้าง ซึ่งมีการนับและคิดค่าใช้จ่ายตามจำนวน

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.definition: Bir dil modelinin yanıt üretirken oluşturduğu jeton sayısı. Uzun yanıtlar daha çok jeton ürettiğinden genellikle daha pahalıdır.
ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.gloss: Bir modelin ürettiği ve çıktı maliyeti üzerinden sayılan jetonlar.

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.text: Asking for 2,000 words doubles the output cost of asking for 200.

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.text: Asking for 2,000 words doubles the output cost of asking for 200.

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.text: Asking for 2,000 words doubles the output cost of asking for 200.

ccb875164bc177cf632cbd4fb69a7a910e7ccca4.text: Asking for 2,000 words doubles the output cost of asking for 200.

Put into a standard symbolic form.
ccc0e8da6b80e08e80d75a89afe11e8f2d5cd0f2.gloss: Put into a standard symbolic form.

ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.definition: The strain that appears when one person is expected to be two things at once and the two pull in different directions.
ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.gloss: The strain that appears when one person is expected to be two things at once and the two pull in different directions.

ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.definition: 一人が二つの役割を同時に期待され、その二つが互いに異なる方向を引く場合に生じる負担や緊張。努力不足とは区別される。
ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.gloss: 二つの役割を同時に求められるときに生じる緊張。

ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.definition: 한 사람에게 둘 이상의 역할을 동시에 기대할 때 발생하는 갈등을 말한다. 둘 중 하나를 선택하면 다른 기대를 어기게 되는 경우가 많다.
ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.gloss: 한 사람에게 요구되는 두 역할이 서로 다른 방향으로 당기는 긴장.

ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.definition: Situação em que as responsabilidades de um papel entram em conflito com as de outro. O problema está nas expectativas incompatíveis, e não necessariamente na capacidade ou no esforço da pessoa.
ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.gloss: Tensão entre exigências de papéis diferentes esperados para a mesma pessoa.

ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.definition: Tekanan yang muncul ketika seseorang diharapkan menjalankan dua peran sekaligus, sedangkan tuntutan kedua peran itu saling bertentangan. Ketegangan ini tidak selalu menunjukkan kegagalan.
ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.gloss: Ketegangan ketika satu orang harus menjalankan dua peran dengan tuntutan yang bertentangan.

ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.definition: แรงตึงเครียดที่เกิดจากการมีบทบาทขัดกัน เช่น เมื่อคนหนึ่งต้องทำหน้าที่ของสองตำแหน่งที่ต้องการงานและเวลาคนละแบบ คำนี้ไม่ได้หมายถึงความล้มเหลวของบุคคล แต่เป็นปัญหาจากการจัดงาน
ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.gloss: ความตึงเครียดที่เกิดเมื่อคนหนึ่งถูกคาดหวังให้เป็นสองอย่างพร้อมกันและทั้งสองอย่างดึงไปคนละทาง

ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.definition: Aynı kişiden aynı anda beklenen iki görevin farklı yönlere çekmesi sonucu ortaya çıkan uyumsuzluk ve stres. Kişinin çabasının yetersizliğinden değil, rollerin çatışmasından kaynaklanır.

ccec6396f5cde7619eb40b38897f6588e85cbf45.translation: Rol çatışması bir çaba eksikliği değildi; aynı haftaya iki iş verilmişti.

ccfb43a24aee8de7e1d03b8d0ff023976eb2ce4e.definition: The move that puts the two sides in the wrong places, crediting the harm to the person who suffered it.

ccfb43a24aee8de7e1d03b8d0ff023976eb2ce4e.definition: 加害者だった人物を被害者に見立て、被害を受けた人物に害boxing Plains加えたりの役割を帰すことを指す。責任の所在を逆転させる手法である。
